name: Consistencia de Profundidad
algorithm: Depth Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes depth consistency across video frames for deepfake and manipulation detection:

1. **Monocular Profundidad Estimación**: Per-frame relative depth maps are estimated using monocular depth cues: texture gradients, defocus, atmospheric perspective, relative size, and occlusion relationships. Each pixel receives a relative depth value consistent with the scene geometry.

2. **Temporal Profundidad Estabilidad**: Depth maps across consecutive frames should show smooth, physically motivated changes. The method tracks depth map evolution — natural scene depth changes are caused by camera motion (smooth, globally coherent) or object motion (local, bounded). Deepfakes may produce temporally unstable depth maps, especially at face-swap boundaries where generated face depth differs from the original face geometry.

3. **Rostro - Scene Profundidad Integración**: The depth relationship between the face and surrounding scene must be consistent. The method checks: (a) face depth varies correctly with camera distance, (b) face depth matches nearby objects at similar distances, (c) face depth changes are consistent with measured face scale changes. Composited deepfake faces may show depth inconsistencies with the scene.

4. **Profundidad - Defocus Consistencia**: Estimated depth should correlate with defocus blur — objects at similar depths should show similar focus. The method cross-validates depth estimates against local defocus measures. AI-generated faces may show incorrect depth-defocus relationships, appearing sharp at depths where the background is blurred (or vice versa).

5. **3D Geométrico Consistencia Puntuación**: The implied 3D geometry is checked for physical plausibility. Face orientation (from landmarks) should produce consistent depth gradients. Perspective distortion should match the estimated camera parameters. Violations of geometric consistency indicate manipulation, yielding an elevated forensic score.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante depth consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
